articles.title: Shipyard winds down IPFS work after Protocol Labs ends funding
articles.snippet: The funding loss leaves InterPlanetary File System software without dedicated maintainers and puts the future of key public services in Protocol Labs’ hands.

articles.title: Coinbase-affiliated advocacy group endorses candidates for US midterms
articles.snippet: With just over two months until the US general election, Stand With Crypto announced its pick for politicians in its efforts to “elect the most pro-crypto Congress in history.”

articles.title: Crypto advocacy groups oppose Illinois digital asset tax in court
articles.snippet: Following a similar lawsuit filed by the Digital Chamber in July, two digital asset advocacy groups challenged Illinois’ 0.2% crypto tax on constitutional and due process grounds.
